topics.title: Display using WRKACTJOB
topics.snippet: Use the IBM i WRKACTJOB command to display server jobs. The WRKACTJOB command shows all active jobs, as well as the server daemons and the server mapper daemon. The following figures show a sample status with the WRKACTJOB command.

topics.title: Verifying that prestart jobs are running
topics.snippet: The prestart job used for a TCP/IP connection is: QZDASOINIT - Server program QZDASSINIT - Server program used when using SSL To verify a prestart job is running use one of the following: WRKACTJOB SBS(QUSRWRK) WRKACTJOB SBS('user-defined-subsystem') The appropriate prestart job should be active: Job, You must use F14 - Include from the WRKACTJOB panel.
